about: Deckhand's pi integration (docs/HARNESSES.md). Deckhand starts every pi tab with one `-e <this folder>/extensions/<name>` per extension listed here that is required, or optional and turned on in Settings (the Settings tab's "pi extensions" group; `default` until the user chooses), in this order. Optional ones show `does` as their one line there. Nothing is written to pi's settings.

extensions.name: bridge
extensions.does: the pi tab's connection to Deckhand: status, session id, waits, prompts, reload, comments, panels and other extensions' commands

extensions.name: desk
extensions.does: Atlas's tools (Home only): desk_state, desk_run, desk_prompt, desk_wait, desk_watch, desk_events and the app tools

extensions.name: browser
extensions.does: browser_* tools, desk_show (a file shown to the user in a tab) and a pi tab's app_* tools, for its own session's tabs

extensions.name: panels
extensions.does: the Todos (rpiv-todo), Subagents (pi-subagents) and Shells (shell, or pi-kit's) panels; steps back for a producer that claims them

extensions.name: guardrails
extensions.does: your ask/block rules on shell commands, read-only chats enforced, secrets redacted from tool output

extensions.name: shell
extensions.does: background shells, monitors and timers (bash_bg, monitor, wake_later) with a Shells panel; off beside another such shell

extensions.name: notes
extensions.does: reminds the session to update its session note before pi compacts; for people who keep notes
